name: Quick Notes
description: A data-only quick-notes demo for DSH Mobile, used to show install from a local file: download dsh-plugin.json from the repository, then open Settings -> Plugins -> INSTALL PLUGIN -> FROM FILE and pick it. The pack adds a Notes page with the import instructions, a Quick Notes card on the Now screen, and a NOTE composer chip that inserts a one-line note prompt. It contains no code, no network access and no storage of its own: the file is the whole plugin, and the app renders it.
author: DSH Mobile Samples

body.title: Quick notes
body.intro: One page, one home card and one composer chip: everything this pack adds comes from dsh-plugin.json.

rows.label: HOW
rows.value: Settings -> Plugins -> INSTALL PLUGIN -> FROM FILE
rows.note: Choose the dsh-plugin.json you downloaded from the repository or copied to the phone.

rows.label: SOURCE
rows.note: Download the raw file from github.com/James0507-cell/dsh-plugin-quick-notes, or copy it over USB.

rows.label: LIMIT
rows.note: The app refuses a larger document. This sample is a few kilobytes; the file must stay valid UTF-8 JSON.

rows.label: DATA ONLY
rows.note: The pack stores nothing itself; notes you type stay in the chat session.

actions.label: SAY HI
actions.value: Quick Notes is data only: no notes are stored by this pack.
